requirements.text: The sample(s) of the ESA shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each ESA sample (e.g. radar, camera, PDC sensor, lighting module) for the manufacturer's trade name or mark and type designation, and check that the marking is legible and survives a rub/indelibility check.

requirements.text: ESAs, which are intentional RF transmitters, which have not received type approval in conjunction with a vehicle manufacturer, shall be supplied with suitable installation guidelines.
requirements.test_case: Check that the delivery documentation of each intentional RF transmitter ESA includes suitable installation guidelines; pass if present and adequate.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each approved ESA for the approval mark per paragraph 5.3; pass if affixed.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark; pass if it shows a circle with letter E and the correct country number.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark; pass if '10R-' and the approval number appear to the right of the circle.

requirements.text: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review design/installation of bumper ESAs and harness and EMC test results; pass if the vehicle complies with R10 in normal use.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Verify ESA test reports cover radiated and conducted emissions and radiated and conducted immunity; pass if all four are tested and passed.

requirements.text: The broadband electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Review test report confirming broadband emission measurement of each ESA per Annex 7.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband emissions per Annex 7; pass if below the logarithmic limit line 62-52 dBµV/m (30-75 MHz) and 52-63 dBµV/m (75-400 MHz).

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband emissions per Annex 7 in 400-1,000 MHz; pass if below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured ESA broadband emission values with limits; pass if all below.

requirements.text: The narrowband electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Review test report confirming narrowband emission measurement of each ESA per Annex 8.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband emissions per Annex 8; pass if below 52-42 dBµV/m (30-75 MHz) and 42-53 dBµV/m (75-400 MHz) limit lines.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband emissions per Annex 8 in 400-1,000 MHz; pass if below 53 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured narrowband value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured ESA narrowband emission values with limits; pass if all below.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances on 12/24 V supply lines of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Review test report confirming transient emission test per ISO 7637-2 / Annex 10.

requirements.text: For positive polarity, the maximum allowed pulse amplitude of the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA transient emissions per ISO 7637-2; pass if positive pulses do not exceed +75 V (12 V) / +150 V (24 V).

requirements.text: For negative polarity, the maximum allowed pulse amplitude of the ESA shall be -100 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and -450 V for vehicles with 24 V systems as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA transient emissions per ISO 7637-2; pass if negative pulses do not exceed -100 V (12 V) / -450 V (24 V).

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Review test report confirming ESA radiated immunity tested with Annex 9 method(s).

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation such that test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: Verify applied levels in >90% of band per Table 2a (e.g. ALSE 30 V/m 80-2,000 MHz, 10 V/m 2-6 GHz; BCI 60 mA) with no function degradation.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation such that test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band is as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Verify applied levels never fall below Table 2b minimum (e.g. ALSE 25 V/m / 8 V/m, BCI 50 mA) over the whole band.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation by the method(s) as described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Review test report confirming Annex 9 method(s) used for ESA immunity.

requirements.text: During the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" of the ESA representative of its type.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 9 radiated immunity tests on each ESA (radar/LIDAR, camera, PDC, pedestrian impact sensors, lighting) and verify no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Check the Annex 10 test report shows ISO 16750-2 starting profile and ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b at Table 3a/3b levels.

requirements.text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply 500 pulses 1 at -75 V (12 V) or -450 V (24 V) and verify FPSC III is achieved.

requirements.text: For pulse 2a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +37 V (12V system) or +37 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply 500 pulses 2a at +37 V and verify FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for others.

requirements.text: For pulse 2b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +10 V (12V system) or +20 V (24V system) for 10 pulses with FPSC II for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply 10 pulses 2b at +10 V (12 V) or +20 V (24 V) and verify FPSC II for immunity related functions and FPSC III for others.

requirements.text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V) or -150 V (24 V) for 1 h and verify FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for others.

requirements.text: For pulse 3b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +75 V (12V system) or +150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 3b at +75 V (12 V) or +150 V (24 V) for 1 h and verify FPSC I for immunity related functions and FPSC III for others.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Verify the transient immunity report classifies pulse results using ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

requirements.text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the starting profile test report evaluates results using ISO 16750-1 functional status classes.

requirements.text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: Apply 10 starting profile pulses at level II on 12 V supply and verify the functional status class B/D/C as applicable.

requirements.text: For the 24 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: Apply 10 starting profile pulses at level II on 24 V supply and verify the functional status class B/D/C as applicable.

requirements.text: RF transmitters shall be tested in the transmit mode.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test plan and report show the radar/keyless transmitter operating in transmit mode during EMC tests.

requirements.text: Spurious emissions of RF transmitters shall be subject to this Regulation, except that wanted emissions within the necessary bandwidth and out of band emissions are disregarded for the purpose of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate emission measurements against limits excluding the necessary bandwidth and out-of-band region, and verify spurious emissions comply.

requirements.text: For the 30-75 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband reference limit shall be E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 with a 120 kHz bandwidth from 30-75 MHz; pass if all levels are at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: For the 75-400 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband reference limit shall be E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions with a 120 kHz bandwidth from 75-400 MHz; pass if all levels are at or below 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: For the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband reference limit shall be E = 63 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions with a 120 kHz bandwidth from 400-1,000 MHz; pass if all levels are at or below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: For the 30-75 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband reference limit shall be E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions with a 120 kHz bandwidth from 30-75 MHz; pass if all levels are at or below 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: For the 75-400 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband reference limit shall be E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions with a 120 kHz bandwidth from 75-400 MHz; pass if all levels are at or below 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: For the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband reference limit shall be E = 53 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions with a 120 kHz bandwidth from 400-1,000 MHz; pass if all levels are at or below 53 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex, the test of broadband electromagnetic emissions from ESAs shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the radiated broadband emission test report of each bumper ESA and confirm it was performed according to CISPR 25.

requirements.text: During the Annex 7 broadband electromagnetic-emission test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Check the test plan and report to confirm each ESA was operated in normal operation mode, preferably at maximum load (e.g. radar transmitting, heater on), during the broadband emission measurement.

requirements.text: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the radiated broadband emission test of each bumper ESA used the ALSE method of CISPR 25 Clause 6.4.

requirements.text: The limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Verify the ESA broadband emission measurement covers 30 to 1,000 MHz and all measured values are below the limits throughout that range.

requirements.text: If peak detectors are used for the measurements, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Review the broadband emission test report: where peak detection was used, confirm the 20 dB CISPR 12 correction was applied before comparison with the limits of paragraphs 6.5./7.10.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex, the test to measure the narrowband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the narrowband emission test report and confirm the test was performed according to CISPR 25 except where Annex 8 states otherwise.

requirements.text: During the Annex 8 narrowband electromagnetic-emission test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Check the test plan and report: the ESA (e.g. radar heater, sensors, lighting) is operated in normal operation mode, preferably at maximum load, during the narrowband emission test.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission test of the ESA shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report states the ALSE method of CISPR 25 paragraph 6.4 was used for the test set-up.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Verify the ESA narrowband emissions measured over 30 to 1,000 MHz in ALSE or OATS are below the limits across the full range.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Confirm in the report and instrument settings that an average detector was used.

requirements.text: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered: (a) Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2; (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3; (c) Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4; (d) Stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5; (e) Reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Review the test plan/report and confirm the chosen combination of ISO 11452 methods covers the full 20 to 6,000 MHz range.

requirements.text: The frequency range and general test conditions for the immunity tests of ESAs to electromagnetic radiation shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report references ISO 11452-1 for frequency range and general test conditions.

requirements.text: The test conditions for the ESA during tests shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Audit the test setup and report for conformity with ISO 11452-1 test conditions.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on.
requirements.test_case: Confirm in the test report that each bumper ESA was powered on during exposure.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test plan defines stimulation (e.g. radar target simulation, sensor loads) putting each ESA into normal operation during the test.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test arrangement photos/description against Annex 9 and the applicable ISO 11452 part.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report covers 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 step sizes and the ESA meets its performance criteria throughout.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows AM 1 kHz 80 per cent modulation used from 20 to 400 MHz.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows PM2 (Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs) used from 2,700 to 3,100 MHz.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows PM3 (Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs) used from 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz.

requirements.text: Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify step size and dwell time in the test report comply with ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: For the absorber chamber test, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the ALSE test report states field calibration by substitution method per ISO 11452-2.

requirements.text: The absorber chamber test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.test_case: Verify the ALSE test report shows vertical antenna polarization.

requirements.text: The TEM cell test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report and confirm the TEM cell immunity test was run per ISO 11452-3 with the ESA meeting its performance criteria.

requirements.text: The bulk current injection test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA; or BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA, except that as an alternative the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Check the BCI test setup records: ISO 11452-4 bench with probe at 150 mm (substitution) or 900 mm (closed loop), or in-vehicle per ISO 11451-4 at 150 mm, and ESA passes.

requirements.text: The stripline test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report and confirm the stripline immunity test was performed per ISO 11452-5 with the ESA meeting its performance criteria.

requirements.text: The reverberation chamber test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report and confirm the reverberation chamber test was performed per ISO 11452-11 with the ESA meeting its performance criteria.

requirements.text: The test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 10 transient immunity tests on each ESA of the bumper and confirm the required functional status is maintained.

requirements.text: The test method shall limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.
requirements.test_case: Measure conducted transient emissions of each ESA on the supply lines per Annex 10 and confirm they are within the regulation limits.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the supply lines and operationally connected lines of each ESA and verify the FPSC per Table 3b is met.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the supply lines of each ESA (unless documented as EV-only) and verify the required functional status class is reached.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Measure transient emissions per ISO 7637-2 on the supply and operationally connected lines of each ESA and confirm they do not exceed the limits of the Regulation.

requirements.text: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installed bumper external surface for outward pointed, sharp or injurious projections; none shall be present.

requirements.text: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installed bumper for outward-directed parts (e.g. hooks, towing cover edges) that could catch a person; none shall be present.

requirements.text: No protruding part of the external surface shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, except that this requirement shall not apply to parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure radii of curvature of protruding bumper parts (≥5 mm projection) with radius gauge; all shall be ≥2.5 mm.

requirements.text: The outward facing angles of parts of the external surface which protrude less than 5 mm shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Inspect bumper parts protruding between 1.5 mm and 5 mm; outward facing angles shall be blunted.

requirements.text: Protruding parts of the external surface, made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 shore A, shall be permitted to have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure Shore A hardness of soft protruding parts; if ≤60 Shore A, radius below 2.5 mm is accepted.

requirements.text: The hardness measurement shall be taken with the component as installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify hardness test record shows measurement on the component as installed on the vehicle.

requirements.text: Only the general requirements of paragraph 5. shall apply to ornaments on radiator grilles.
requirements.test_case: Assess grille ornaments against paragraph 5 requirements (radii, no sharp or catching parts).

requirements.text: Added ornaments which project more than 10 mm from their support shall retract, become detached or bend over under a force of 10 daN exerted at their most salient point in any direction in a plane approximately parallel to the surface on which they are mounted, except that these provisions shall not apply to ornaments on radiator grilles.
requirements.test_case: Apply 10 daN at most salient point of the ornament parallel to mounting surface; ornament shall retract, detach or bend over.

requirements.text: After the added ornaments are retracted, detached or bent over, the remaining projections shall not project more than 10 mm.
requirements.test_case: After the 10 daN test, measure remaining projection; it shall be ≤10 mm.

requirements.text: Protective strips or shielding on the external surface shall be firmly secured to the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check by manual pull/inspection that protective strips on the bumper are firmly secured to the vehicle.

requirements.text: For gaps between fixed or movable elements of grilles and gaps of between 40 mm and 25 mm the radii of curvature shall be 1 mm or more.
requirements.test_case: For grille gaps of 25-40 mm, measure element radii of curvature; all shall be ≥1 mm.

requirements.text: If the distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps is equal to or less than 25 mm, the radii of curvature of external faces of the elements shall not be less than 0.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: For grille gaps ≤25 mm, measure radii of external faces of elements; all shall be ≥0.5 mm.

requirements.text: The requirements of paragraph 5.4. shall not apply to gaps between fixed or movable elements, including those forming part of air intake or outlet grilles and radiator grilles, provided that the distance between consecutive elements does not exceed 40 mm and provided that the grilles and gaps have a functional purpose.
requirements.test_case: Measure distance between consecutive grille elements per Annex 3 para 4; confirm ≤40 mm and functional purpose for exemption from 5.4.

requirements.text: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify gap measurements were made per Annex 3 paragraph 4 method.

requirements.text: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each grille element; junctions of front and side faces shall be blunted.

requirements.text: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling, this requirement being considered to be satisfied if either the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork or the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.
requirements.test_case: Check bumper ends are integrated in bodywork or not contactable by a 100 mm sphere with gap to surrounding bodywork ≤20 mm.

requirements.text: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward, and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.
requirements.test_case: Measure radii of curvature of the rigid bumper surface per Annex 3; pass if ≥5 mm within 20 mm inward of the contour line and ≥2.5 mm elsewhere.

requirements.text: The minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm of the bumper shall apply to that part of the zone lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward which is situated between and in front (or rear in case of the rear bumper) of tangential points with the contour line of two vertical planes each forming with the longitudinal plane of symmetry of the vehicle an angle of 15° (see Fig. 1).
requirements.test_case: Determine the 15° tangential points on the plan-view contour and verify the 5 mm radius zone is assessed between and in front of them; pass if all radii in that zone are ≥5 mm.

requirements.text: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. shall not apply to parts on or of the bumper or to bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm, with special reference to joint covers and jets for headlamp washers; but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection of bumper parts/insets (e.g. PDC sensors, sensor covers, trim strips) per Annex 3; pass if parts projecting 1.5 mm to <5 mm have blunted outward facing angles.

requirements.text: The requirement of paragraph 6.5.2. does not apply to the bumper cover, except that the provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation shall remain applicable to the bumper cover.
requirements.test_case: Assess the bumper cover (fascia) against the general requirements of paragraph 5 (radii, projections, 100 mm sphere contact); pass if all applicable paragraph 5 limits are met.

requirements.text: Supporting brackets provided by the vehicle manufacturer for registration plates shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation if they are contactable by a 100 mm diameter sphere when a registration plate is fitted in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's recommendation.
requirements.test_case: Fit a registration plate per the manufacturer's recommendation and probe the license plate holder with a 100 mm sphere; if contactable, verify radii ≥2.5 mm per paragraph 5.4.

requirements.text: Radio receiving and transmitting aerials shall be fitted to the vehicle in such a way that if their unattached end is less than 2 m from the road surface in any position of use specified by the manufacturer of the aerial, the unattached end shall be inside the zone bounded by the vertical planes which are 10 cm inside the extreme outer edge of the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.7. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the aerial unattached end position in all manufacturer-specified positions of use; if less than 2 m above the road, verify it lies at least 10 cm inside the vehicle's extreme outer edge.

requirements.text: Aerials shall be so fitted to the vehicle, and if necessary their unattached ends so restricted, that no part of the aerials protrude beyond the extreme outer edge of the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.7. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect/measure the installed aerial against the vehicle's extreme outer edge per paragraph 2.7; pass if no part protrudes beyond it.

requirements.text: The dimension of a gap or space between elements of a grille shall be determined by the distance between two planes passing through the points of contact of the sphere and perpendicular to the line joining those points of contact.
requirements.test_case: Apply the sphere to the radiator and lower grill openings and measure the distance between the two planes through the contact points perpendicular to the line joining them; the measured gaps are used to check against the main-body grille-gap limits.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible, except that should the adjustment of the factory-fitted lighting devices be disturbed, it may be corrected to conform to the required specifications, provided this can be done by the normal means of adjustment, and bulbs may be replaced in the event of filament failure.
requirements.test_case: After each Annex 3 pendulum/barrier impact, switch on all lighting and signalling devices (incl. bumper-integrated side signalling lamp) and verify correct operation and unobstructed visibility, with only normal-means re-aiming or bulb replacement allowed.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.test_case: After each Annex 3 impact, open and close bonnet, boot lid and all doors by normal means and verify normal operation without binding against the bumper.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.
requirements.test_case: Observe during each Annex 3 impact (e.g. video) that no side door opens; pass if all side doors remain closed.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning.
requirements.test_case: After each Annex 3 impact, inspect radiator/cooling circuit behind grill and fuel system for leaks and deformed lines; pass if no leak and no flow-restricting constriction.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the sealing devices and caps of the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall be operable in the normal manner.
requirements.test_case: After each Annex 3 impact, open and close fuel/charge-port flap and cooling system caps by normal means; pass if they operate normally.

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment, except that this requirement does not apply to sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems, which may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.
requirements.test_case: After each Annex 3 impact, check alignment/adjustment of propulsion, suspension, tyres, steering and brakes; pass if within adjustment (bumper ADAS sensors excluded provided basic braking and steering intact).

requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall operate in a normal manner, except that this requirement does not apply to sensors, cameras, radar devices, etc. being part of driver assist systems, which may become damaged, disoriented or broken due to an impact carried out according to Annex 3 as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.
requirements.test_case: After each Annex 3 impact, function-test propulsion, steering and braking; pass if normal operation, with damage to bumper-mounted radar/camera/PDC sensors accepted if basic braking and steering performance remain intact.

requirements.text: In the two vehicle-loading conditions the protective device between the corners, as defined in paragraph 3.1.5. of this Regulation, shall be intersected by the horizontal plane passing through the reference line.
requirements.test_case: Measure the bumper height at unladen and laden test weight and confirm the 445 mm reference plane intersects it across the full width between the corners.

requirements.text: The first contact of the impactor with the vehicle shall be by the impact contour on the protective device.
requirements.test_case: Use high-speed video or contact marking to confirm that first contact is between the impact contour and the bumper, not other body parts.

requirements.text: The reference height shall be 445 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the impactor reference line above ground and confirm it is 445 mm.

requirements.text: The longitudinal impact test shall consist of two impacts on the front surface and two impacts on the rear surface of the vehicle, on each surface one impact being made with the vehicle under "unladen weight", as defined in paragraph 3.1.3. of this Regulation, and the other with the vehicle under "laden test weight", as defined in paragraph 3.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test report contains two front longitudinal impacts, one at unladen weight and one at laden test weight.

requirements.text: For the impacts on the front and rear surfaces, the choice of location of the impactor for the first impact is free, but for the second impact the median plane of the impactor shall be at a distance at least 300 mm from the first, provided that during these impacts the extremities of the impactor do not pass outside a zone defined by two planes parallel to the longitudinal median plane and passing through the corners of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral offset between the two impact locations (at least 300 mm) and confirm the impactor stays within the corner planes.

requirements.text: For the longitudinal impact test, the vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 4 km/h +0.25/-0.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impact speed and confirm it is between 4.0 and 4.25 km/h.

requirements.text: The corner impact test shall consist of an impact at one front corner and an impact at one rear corner of the vehicle, which is at unladen weight (see paragraph 3.1.3. of the Regulation), and an impact at the other front corner and the other rear corner with the vehicle at the weight given in paragraph 3.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test report contains one front corner impact at unladen weight and the other front corner at laden test weight.

requirements.text: For the corner impact test, plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the angle between plane A and the vehicle median plane and confirm it is 55° to 65°.

requirements.text: For the corner impact test, the point of the first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm).
requirements.test_case: Measure the first-contact point offset from the impactor median plane and confirm it is within ±25 mm.

requirements.text: For the corner impact test, the vehicle should be impacted at a speed of 2.5 km/h +0.1/-0.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impact speed and confirm it is between 2.5 and 2.6 km/h.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, the lighting and light-signalling devices retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the fitting of the bumper-mounted lamps and run a vibration/durability check on the vehicle; pass if lamp position, orientation and photometric characteristics remain within R48 requirements afterwards.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp mountings in the bumper module and apply normal handling and service loads; pass if the lamp aim and position cannot change without deliberate use of an adjustment means or tool.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road, with a tolerance of ±3° in each direction.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reference axis of the fitted side signalling lamp relative to the road bearing plane; pass if parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of all other signalling devices, with a tolerance of ±3° in each direction.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reference axis of the fitted signalling lamp relative to the median longitudinal plane; pass if parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of light-signalling devices laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Compare the installation against the manufacturer's fitting instructions; pass if all instructions are followed.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps, with a tolerance of ±3° in each direction.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reference axis of the side-marker lamp/side retro-reflector relative to the median longitudinal plane; pass if perpendicular within ±3°.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.test_case: Measure lamp height and orientation with the vehicle unladen on a flat horizontal surface; pass if values meet the installation requirements in that condition.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Measure the left and right side lamp positions relative to the vehicle centreline based on exterior lamp form; pass if symmetrical.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the exterior shape of the left and right lamps; pass if they are mirror-symmetrical about the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of both lamps of the pair; pass if both meet the same colour requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Compare photometric approval data/measurements of left and right lamps; pass if substantially identical.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the front of the vehicle for logos in lamps; pass if at most two lateral or one central logo is present.

requirements.text: All logos in lamps that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos shall be prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect any logo in the lamps; pass if it is a vehicle or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Check each grouped/combined/incorporated function against its colour, position, orientation, visibility and electrical connection requirements; pass if all are met.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with all other grouped/combined/incorporated functions OFF; pass if requirements are met.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch ON the position lamp and the incorporated function together and measure chromaticity; pass if each function's colour requirement is met.

requirements.text: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: With the bumper lamps installed on the vehicle, check visibility from the rear per 5.10.4.2; pass if no white light is visible.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Measure lamp mounting height at highest and lowest points of the apparent surface; pass if within the limits for the function.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Operate each bumper lamp switched ON and measure intensity, colour and apparent surface over time; pass if no intentional variation occurs unless specifically permitted.

requirements.text: Direction-indicator lamps, the vehicle-hazard warning signal, amber side-marker lamps complying with paragraph 6.18.7., and the emergency stop signal shall be flashing lamps.
requirements.test_case: Activate the direction indicator/hazard warning function and verify the side signalling lamp flashes.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, or when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Where intensity varies with ambient light, other lamps or another function, measure photometry in each state; pass if each state complies with the lamp's technical provisions.

requirements.text: To verify paragraph 5.10.2., for the visibility of white light towards the rear of a vehicle, with the exception of reversing lamps and white side conspicuity markings, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a white lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 2 in a transverse plane situated 25 m behind the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Observer moves within Zone 2 in a transverse plane 25 m behind the vehicle; pass if the apparent surface of no white front bumper lamp is directly visible.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously, except while one or more of the following conditions exist: (a) Front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps; (b) Side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators; (c) Daytime running lamps are switched ON; (d) Front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
requirements.test_case: Operate the light switch and verify the bumper position/side-marker lamps switch ON and OFF simultaneously with the other listed lamps, outside the exempted conditions.

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the bumper lamps; pass if no signalling or decorative lamp is concealable (only headlamps/front fog lamps may be concealed when not in use).

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamp shall emit amber light.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the emitted light and confirm it lies within the amber colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamp shall emit amber light, except that the rearmost side-marker lamp can be red if it is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp or is grouped or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of the side-marker lamp in the front bumper and confirm it is amber.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count the lamps of each function fitted in the bumper on the vehicle and compare with the number prescribed in the individual specifications.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Check the installed bumper lamps (CAD/vehicle) for obstruction by fascia, grill or other parts within the required geometric visibility angles; pass if no obstacle except those present at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of the installed lamp with the masking vehicle parts; pass if the unhidden part meets the device approval photometric values.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each regulated lamp in the bumper for a valid device approval mark (e.g. UN R148/R149) matching paragraph 6; pass if present.

requirements.text: Especially in case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check that any signalling lamp with a logo carries a UN R148 approval mark.

requirements.text: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only, except that this requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect fitted light sources against lamp approval categories; pass if only R37/R99/R128-approved sources of the approved categories are fitted.

requirements.text: Arrangement "A" of direction-indicator lamps shall apply to all motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Check the installed direction-indicator lamps against arrangement A of paragraph 6.5.3.

requirements.text: The presence of direction-indicator lamps shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle lighting arrangement and confirm direction-indicator lamps are fitted.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamps shall be type-approved according to the 01 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 6, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Verify the lamp carries a valid UN R6 (01+) or UN R148 (00+) approval mark and certificate.

requirements.text: The number of direction-indicator lamps shall be according to the arrangement.
requirements.test_case: Count the installed direction-indicator lamps and verify they match arrangement A.

requirements.text: Arrangement A shall comprise two side direction-indicator lamps of category 5 (minimum requirement) for all M1 vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Verify two side direction-indicator lamps of at least category 5 are fitted to the M1 vehicle.

requirements.text: The height above the ground of the light-emitting surface of the side direction-indicator lamps of categories 5 or 6 shall not be less than 350 mm for M1 and N1 category of vehicles, and 500 mm for all other categories of vehicles, both measured from the lowest point.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of lowest point of the light-emitting surface above ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if ≥ 350 mm for M1.

requirements.text: The height above the ground of the light-emitting surface of the side direction-indicator lamps of categories 5 or 6 shall not be more than 1,500 mm, measured from the highest point.
requirements.test_case: Measure height of highest point of the light-emitting surface above ground; pass if ≤ 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: In length, the distance between the light-emitting surface of the side direction-indicator lamp (categories 5 and 6) and the transverse plane which marks the forward boundary of the vehicle's overall length shall not exceed 1,800 mm, except that this distance shall not exceed 2,500 mm for M1 and N1 category vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Measure longitudinal distance from the light-emitting surface to the vehicle's front boundary plane; pass if ≤ 2,500 mm for M1.

requirements.text: The vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 15° above and below the horizontal for direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b and 5, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional rear lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure on vehicle the vertical visibility of the apparent surface; verify visible from 15° up to 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The horizontal angles of geometric visibility of the direction-indicator lamps shall be as shown in the figure of paragraph 6.5., the value of 5° given for dead angle of visibility to the rear of the side direction-indicator being an upper limit d ≤ 1.80 m (for M1 and N1 category vehicles d ≤ 2.50 m), except that for the direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a and 2b mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure horizontal visibility angles on vehicle against the figure; verify inward/outward angles met and side DI dead angle d ≤ 2.50 m for M1.

requirements.text: The vertical angles of geometric visibility shall be 30° above and 5° below the horizontal for direction indicator lamps of category 6.
requirements.test_case: Measure on vehicle the vertical visibility; verify visible from 30° above to 5° below the horizontal.

requirements.text: The orientation of the direction-indicator lamps shall be according to the specifications for installation by the manufacturer, if any.
requirements.test_case: Compare installed lamp orientation with the manufacturer's installation specification.

requirements.text: The direction-indicator lamps shall switch ON independently of the other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Activate direction indicator with all other lamps OFF and ON; verify independent switching.

requirements.text: All direction-indicator lamps on one side of a vehicle shall flash in phase.
requirements.test_case: Record lamp outputs on one side with oscilloscope/photodiodes; verify in-phase flashing.

requirements.text: On M1 and N1 vehicles less than 6 m in length, with an arrangement complying with paragraph 6.5.5.2., the amber side-marker lamps, when mounted, shall also flash at the same frequency (in phase) with the direction-indicator lamps.
requirements.test_case: Activate indicators; verify amber side-marker lamp flashes at same frequency in phase with direction indicators.

requirements.text: The light of the direction-indicator lamps shall be a flashing light flashing 90 ± 30 times per minute.
requirements.test_case: Measure flash frequency on vehicle; verify 60 to 120 flashes per minute.

requirements.text: On M1 and N1 category vehicles less than 6 m in length, side-marker lamps shall be used, if they supplement the reduced geometric visibility requirements of front position lamps conforming to paragraph 6.9.5.2. and rear position lamps conforming to paragraph 6.10.5.2.
requirements.test_case: Check whether front position lamps use the reduced geometric visibility of 6.9.5.2; if so verify side-marker lamps are fitted.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall be optional on all other vehicles, and the SM1 or SM2 types of side-marker lamps may be used.
requirements.test_case: Verify the side-marker lamp is of type SM1 or SM2 per its approval marking.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 91, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp carries a valid UN R91 or UN R148 approval mark.

requirements.text: The minimum number of side-marker lamps per side shall be such that the rules for longitudinal positioning are complied with.
requirements.test_case: Count side-marker lamps per side and compare with the longitudinal positioning rules.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).
requirements.test_case: Measure apparent surface heights on the unladen vehicle; pass if ≥ 250 mm and ≤ 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: In length, at least one side-marker lamp shall be fitted to the middle third of the vehicle, the foremost side-marker lamp being not further than 3 m (4 m for semi-trailers) from the front, except that for vehicles the length of which does not exceed 6 m and for chassis-cabs it is sufficient to have one side-marker lamp fitted within the first third and/or within the last third of the vehicle length, and for M1 vehicles the length of which exceeds 6 m but does not exceed 7 m it is sufficient to have one side-marker lamp fitted not further than 3 m from the front and one within the last third of the vehicle length.
requirements.test_case: Measure the longitudinal position of the side-marker lamp on the vehicle against vehicle length and verify it lies within the permitted third/distance from the front.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° to the front and to the rear, except that for vehicles on which the installation of the side-marker lamps is optional this value can be reduced to 30°.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed lamp that the apparent surface is visible over 45° (or 30° where optional) to the front and to the rear in the horizontal plane.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure mounting height and verify the apparent surface is visible 10° above and 10° (or 5° if below 750 mm) below the horizontal.

requirements.text: If the vehicle is equipped with side-marker lamps used to supplement the reduced geometric visibility of front and rear direction indicator lamps conforming to paragraph 6.5.5.2. and/or position lamps conforming to paragraphs 6.9.5.2. and 6.10.5.2., the horizontal angles of geometric visibility of the side-marker lamps shall be 45° towards the front and rear ends of the vehicle and 30° towards the centre of the vehicle (see the figure in paragraph 6.5.5.2.).
requirements.test_case: Verify geometric visibility of the side-marker lamp is 45° towards the vehicle end and 30° towards the vehicle centre.

requirements.text: The side-marker lamps shall be oriented towards the side.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp and verify its reference axis points laterally outwards.

requirements.text: On M1 and N1 category vehicles less than 6 m in length amber side-marker lamps may be wired to flash, provided that this flashing is in phase and at the same frequency with the direction-indicator lamps at the same side of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Activate the direction indicator and verify the amber side-marker lamp flashes in phase and at the same frequency as the direction-indicator lamps on the same side.

requirements.text: If the answer-back signal flashes, the frequency shall not exceed 2.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Activate the answer-back signal (lock/unlock) and measure the flash frequency; pass if it is not more than 2.0 Hz.

requirements.text: The answer-back signal shall be provided by approved lighting and light-signalling devices and exterior courtesy lamps where in all these cases, the maximum luminous intensity per lamp does not exceed 700 cd on or above the HH line, except that front fog lamps, rear fog lamps and stop lamps are not permitted to be used.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval markings of the lamps used and measure their intensity in answer-back mode; pass if each lamp is approved, gives not more than 700 cd on or above the HH line, and is not a front fog lamp.

requirements.text: The answer-back signal may only be activated automatically in conjunction with the locking and unlocking of the door(s) and/or the detection of the vehicle user in proximity to the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Functional test of the activation triggers; pass if the signal is activated only on door locking/unlocking and/or user proximity detection.

requirements.text: The duration of the optical indication of the answer-back signal shall not exceed 3 seconds, this time being defined from the beginning to the end of the signal, irrespective of whether it contains flashes, variations of intensity or variations in apparent surface.
requirements.test_case: Time the answer-back signal from its start to its end; pass if the duration is not more than 3 s.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of less than 425 mm the requirements of paragraph 5.1.1. shall be applied for the legform test to bumper.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height at each test position; if below 425 mm, verify the flexible lower legform test of paragraph 5.1.1 is applied.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform flexible lower legform impacts per Annex 5 para 1 at all test positions; pass if absolute peak MCL elongation is at most 22 mm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform flexible lower legform impacts per Annex 5 para 1; pass if peak ACL and PCL elongations are each at most 13 mm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform flexible lower legform impacts per Annex 5 para 1; pass if absolute tibia bending moments are at most 340 Nm at all tibia gauges.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 1. (Flexible lower legform impactor), the manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm, except that a Contracting Party may restrict application of the relaxation zone requirement in its domestic legislation if it decides that such restriction is appropriate.
requirements.test_case: Check nominated relaxation widths total at most 264 mm and that tibia bending moments in these zones are at most 380 Nm.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position which is greater than, or equal to, 425 mm and less than 500 mm the requirements of either paragraph 5.1.1. or 5.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied for the legform test to bumper.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if 425 mm to <500 mm, verify that the manufacturer-chosen test (5.1.1 or 5.1.2) is applied and documented.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm the requirements of paragraph 5.1.2. shall be applied for the legform test to bumper.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if at least 500 mm, verify the upper legform to bumper test of paragraph 5.1.2 is applied.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
requirements.test_case: Perform upper legform to bumper impacts per Annex 5 para 2; pass if instantaneous sum of impact forces is at most 7.5 kN.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform upper legform to bumper impacts per Annex 5 para 2; pass if bending moment on the impactor is at most 510 Nm.

requirements.text: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.
requirements.test_case: Verify cut-body content against BOM; pass if complete front bumper module (fascia, absorber, beam, lower stiffener, sensors, brackets) and all contributory front structure are included.

requirements.text: Vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position shall require the vehicle to comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.
requirements.test_case: Identify movable bumper components and test/assess pedestrian impact compliance in each fixed position; pass if limits met in every position.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the flexible lower legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure impactor velocity at first contact (gravity-corrected): within 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: For the flexible lower legform impactor tests, the selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the test plan: every lower legform impact point lies within the bumper test area defined per paragraph 2.14.

requirements.text: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report: at least three lower legform tests, one in the middle and one in each outer third of the bumper test area, at worst-case positions.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Check in the upper legform to bumper test records that the impactor velocity measured at bumper contact is within 10.9 to 11.3 m/s.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp drawing/sample; pass if space sufficient for approval marking and other markings is provided.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visual check and rub test of markings; pass if legible and not removed.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure approval marking dimension a; pass if ≥ 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking; pass if circle with E and country number is present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking; pass if 4-6 digit sequential number matching the approval number is present.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking layout; pass if sequential number is adjacent to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking; pass if function symbol(s) per Table 1 are present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking; pass if '148R' followed by series digits (e.g. 00/01) is present.

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall consist of a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking of handed lamps; pass if horizontal arrow indicating mounting position is present.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed towards the front of the vehicle in the case of direction indicators of categories 5 and 6 and combined parking lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect arrow on marking; pass if pointing towards the vehicle front when installed.

requirements.text: On lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps, the approval marking shall consist of the additional letter "D" to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking; pass if letter D appears right of the function symbol.

requirements.text: On lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system, the approval marking shall consist of the additional letter "Y" to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect marking; pass if letter Y appears right of the function symbol.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp; pass if complete approval marking is present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp; pass if applicant's trade name or mark is present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: Inspect lamp; pass if light source category marking is present.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a legible marking of the rated voltage(s) or voltage range; pass if present.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a legible marking of the rated voltage(s) or voltage range; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each replaceable light source module for the applicant's trade name or mark; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each module for its specific identification code; pass if present.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the external control gear/intensity control for its identification number and manufacturer name; pass if both present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp drawing/sample to verify the approval marking is on a part not separable from the light-emitting transparent part; pass if so.

requirements.text: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
